Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. original_prompt: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Generate a CloudFormation template defining an IAM role with a policy that allows EC2 instances to write logs to CloudWatch and read configuration from Parameter Store.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM role for EC2 instances to write CloudWatch Logs and read configuration from SSM Parameter Store with secure defaults.
Parameters:
  SSMParameterPathPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: /app/
    Description: Prefix path for SSM Parameters the instance is allowed to read (e.g., /app/ or /my/service/)
    AllowedPattern: '^\/([a-zA-Z0-9_.\-\/]+)?$'
Resources:
  Ec2AppRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ec2-cloudwatch-logs-and-ssm-parameter-read
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: SSMParameterReadByPath
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${SSMParameterPathPrefix}*
              - Sid: KMSDecryptForSecureParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    "kms:ViaService": !Sub ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
                  StringLike:
                    "kms:EncryptionContext:aws:ssm:parameter-name": !Sub ${SSMParameterPathPrefix}*
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ec2-logs-and-ssm-parameter-access
  Ec2AppInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref Ec2AppRole
Outputs:
  RoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role for EC2 instances
    Value: !GetAtt Ec2AppRole.Arn
  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Name of the IAM Instance Profile to attach to EC2 instances
    Value: !Ref Ec2AppInstanceProfile
